g.text: PCA visualisation, MM and LR probes, causal interventions, deception probing, attention probes.
Math intuition marked with a blue box. Prerequisites marked with a yellow box.
What a linear probe IS, and why the whole methodology hinges on TWO distinct questions.
A probe is one direction w in activation space.
Classify by sign of x . w.
Does the probe predict the label correctly?
Does intervening on w actually change model behaviour?
A probe can pass Q1 but fail Q2.
MM beats LR here despite similar accuracy.
Extract last-token hidden state per statement, run PCA, sweep every layer with a DoM classifier.
PCA is unsupervised: separation means truth is a PROMINENT axis, not just present.
PCA finds the directions of maximum variance
in a dataset (the eigenvectors of the
covariance matrix). Project onto the top-2
eigenvectors to get the best 2D summary of
Cluster separation implies truth is prominent.
Why last real token? Declarative statements aggregate their meaning at the final
punctuation. GoT paper probes specifically at the period. Right-padding means
last real tok idx = attention_mask.sum(-1) - 1 (not just [:, -1] which lands on PAD).
Layer sweep: where does truth live?
No training, just two means per layer.
Two probe types, both classify well. MM = mass-mean, LR = logistic regression + StandardScaler.
Same accuracy does NOT imply same direction. This becomes causally important in section 3.

buffers so they follow the module.

But: accuracy alone tells you nothing about
A probe direction can classify well without being causally relevant.
TEST: add / subtract w to residual stream and measure P(TRUE) - P(FALSE).
The Spanish word 'jirafa' means 'giraffe'. This statement is: TRUE
The Spanish word 'escribir' means 'to write'. This statement is: TRUE
The Spanish word 'gato' means 'cat'. This statement is: TRUE
The Spanish word 'aire' means 'silver'. This statement is: FALSE
∂ Metric: P(TRUE) - P(FALSE) at last position
NIE_add = mean P_diff(ADD, false) - mean P_diff(NONE, false)
NIE_subtract = mean P_diff(SUBTRACT, true) - mean P_diff(NONE, true)
Higher |NIE| = probe direction is more CAUSALLY implicated.
MM probes typically have higher NIE than LR: this is the headline result.
It can lean on any correlated feature,
including ones the model doesn't use
MM is forced along the BULK direction
of activation shift: more likely to be
what the model actually computes with.
Batch-aware hook: patch only the STATEMENT tokens, not padding, not few-shot prefix
seq_lens = attention_mask.sum(dim=1) # real length per batch element
for b in range(batch): end = seq_lens[b] # then patch positions end-1 and end-2 only
Patch the period + first suffix token only. Get masking wrong = measurement is meaningless.
Switch to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Build instructed-pairs: same content, honest vs deceptive persona.
Then steer generation. Then score dialogues token-by-token.
system: 'You are an honest AI assistant.'
system: 'You are a deceptive AI assistant.'
Format twice: WITH and WITHOUT assistant content.
Diff the two strings to find assistant char span.
Robust across chat templates. No fragile heuristics.
Deceptive INTENT is encoded in acts
before any deceptive tokens are emitted.
Probe target changes: from model state (truth, deception) to input property (is this prompt high-stakes?).
Full-sequence activations + AttnLite: learned query, attention-weighted pool, linear classifier.

Attention weights sum to 1 over positions.
AttnLite has ONE learned query vector
(no keys!) that produces one weight per
position, same query for all inputs.
